## Usage Advice

### Use when

### Avoid when

- Avoid stating it without [`gmeow:coordinateFrame`](gmeow-coordinateFrame.md) and avoid for terrestrial latitude ([`gmeow:latitude`](gmeow-latitude.md)).

### How to use

- Pair [`gmeow:declination`](gmeow-declination.md) with [`gmeow:rightAscension`](gmeow-rightAscension.md) and a declared [`gmeow:coordinateFrame`](gmeow-coordinateFrame.md).
